name: The Key of the Ledgers
start_toast: A Key is located: under the Ghost Markets, in the echo where the Choir keeps its ledgers.
summary: One of the three Keys to the Loom lies under the Ghost Markets, in the echo where the Choir keeps its ledgers. Take it whole, or break it; either way its keeper wakes.

delve.summary: Delve under the Ghost Markets, in the echo where the Choir keeps its ledgers. The Key's keeper will not let it go.

branches.toast: A Key, whole. Two more, or fewer.
A Key, broken. The Loom will not be mended with it.

broken.summary: The Key is broken. Whatever the Loom becomes, it will not be mended.
